reuse.why: The API and forecast reuse getScheduledAmount, but its approximate calculation reimplements the existing getApproxNumberThreshold helper.

duplication.why: The rounded 7.5% tolerance formula is duplicated from shared/rules.ts, creating two definitions of the same policy.

placement.why: Expected-amount selection belongs in shared/schedules.ts, and exposing the derived API field through scheduleModel follows the existing layering.

scope.why: The edits are confined to schedule amount policy, its API representation, forecast integration, and focused tests.

maintainability.why: The helper remains shared, but a rounding parameter now selects midpoint versus minimum policy, while the new optional operator is supplied inconsistently across consumers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts: getScheduledAmount computes the approximate tolerance inline instead of calling getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated tolerance expression is copied directly rather than disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount adds optional amountOp and an isapprox branch; its existing rangeRounding parameter now also selects amount policy, and existing consumers continue calling it without the operator.
